findings: No active Meta ads under your name - five Hyderabad installers (Evergrid, Solox, Truzon, Punarvi, Twilight) are live this month buying the same homeowner with the same Rs. 78,000-subsidy message.

You already run a location-page farm: Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad, Karimnagar and Suryapet in Telangana, plus Nellore, Vijayawada, Visakhapatam, Guntur, Tirupati, Kurnool, Kadapa and Nandyal in Andhra Pradesh. Real, ranking content - with zero paid traffic pointing at it.
The only contact email published is a personal Gmail (origian.ei@gmail.com), even though you own origianpower.com AND origianpower.in. No company-domain inbox is advertised anywhere.
Two Hyderabad offices (Nizampet 500090 and Hitech City 500081) but no Hyderabad-specific paid targeting - the pages exist, nothing buys into them.
The contact form is WPForms behind reCAPTCHA. For a paid click that is one more step between the ad and the phone call.
next_steps: Point a small budget at the pages you already have
You do not need new pages to start. A modest Meta budget aimed at the existing Hyderabad and Nizampet pages is the fastest test.
Publish info@origianpower.com - you already own the domain. A Gmail address on a solar EPC site reads smaller than the service list next to it.
Offer WhatsApp alongside the form, or drop the reCAPTCHA step, so a paid click reaches you in one tap.
Your location pages are in English only. Telugu creative is the language of the Telangana homeowner your competitors are buying.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
